headline: Public hearings on a new auto repair shop at 102 Esten Avenue and outdoor seating at 99 India Street.
summary: The agenda lists license petitions for a car show, a winter light festival, and a one-day celebration at 816 Main Street. It also includes public hearings on restaurants, a hookah lounge, and an auto repair shop, plus kennel and auto shop items to be rescheduled.
items: Car show license petition by Phillip Marques at 45 Alden Street, Saturday, August 15, 2026, 3:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. (LIC#EVT-26-72)

Rhode Island Lights Festival license petition by Centerville Bank Stadium at Tidewater Landing, November 27, 2026 through January 3, 2027. Sundays to Thursdays 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m.; Fridays and Saturdays 5:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. (LIC#EVT-26-71)
Sign permit renewal for Minuteman Press (KS Designs LLC), 805 Central Ave. (LIC#SGN-24-3)
Waste hauler renewal for Rambone Disposal Service (Rambone Disposal Service, Inc.), 2153 Plainfield Pike, Johnston, RI (LIC#WST-24-7)

Entertainment and one-day expansion of premises petition by Societe Jacques Cartier Cercle No. 4 for the Jacques 126th Anniversary Celebration at 816 Main Street, Saturday, August 15, 2026, 11:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. (LIC#EVT-26-69)
Public hearing on Class B (Victualler) expansion of premises to include outdoor seating for Pawtucket Patriot Bar & Grill (Country Lounge Inc.), 99 India St. (LIC#LQB-24-26)
Communication from Ralph Garner, president of Pawtucket Patriot Bar and Grill (Country Lounge Inc.), requesting a name change to Pawtucket Patriot Bar & BBQ
Public hearing on new auto repair shop for Correia Auto Repair (Professional Auto Repair LLC), 102 Esten Avenue, previously Woodlawn Village (LIC#AUT-26-8)

Update on automobile repair shop and second-hand shop licenses (Class A and B) for Tiki's Auto Sales Annex (RZG Inc.), 772 Main St. (LIC#AUT-24-68), to be rescheduled to the first meeting in September 2026. Stipulations: no mechanical repairs in front of the building; no debris in the back; all work inside the building; all vehicles in front for sale only
Formal hearing on kennel renewal for Harmony (Harmony Dog Training LLC), 65 Patterson Ave. (LIC#KNL-25-2), to be rescheduled to the first meeting in September 2026
Kennel renewal for Harmony (Harmony Dog Training LLC), 65 Patterson Ave. (LIC#KNL-25-2), postponed again until the first meeting in September 2026
Formal hearing on Class B (Victualler) license for Mangos Hookah Lounge (Princess Investments LLC), 17 Exchange St. (LIC#LQB-24-53)
Communication from Steven Knapp, Pawtucket resident, about noise pollution from an event at Picos
Formal hearing on Class B (Victualler) license for Picos Restaurant & Hookah Lounge (Picos Restaurant & Lounge LLC), 110 School St. (LIC#LQB-24-60)
Communication from Sgt. Jason Lafond, Pawtucket Police Department, about police response to a large disorderly crowd at 249 Main Street
